bullets.text: In Tiruvallur, angry residents took to the road at midnight due to frequent powercuts, and the office should monitor power supply restoration.
In Velachery, a sudden road subsidence near Nehru Nagar caused traffic disruptions, and the office should coordinate urgent repairs with local traffic police.
The meteorological center issued an orange alert for Chennai and Thiruvallur districts due to heavy rain expectations, and the district team must stay vigilant.
Near Tiruttani, overgrown bushes in a school campus caused fear of venomous creatures among parents and students, so the office should urge authorities to clear them.
Damaged concrete slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB in Tiruvallur put the public at risk, and the office should prompt the State Highways department to fix them.
Artificial intelligence is shifting graduate hiring priorities toward reviewing AI drafts and business fit, and the portfolio team should monitor industry skilling needs.
Cisco executive Jeetu Patel supports unlimited AI access for Gen Z to accelerate software development, and the office should watch this productivity trend.
